answer: An agent that wants to trade must post a refundable 200 POA bond locked 90 days on a single thread of identity tied to one device key, so a farm cannot split one bond across fifty identities or age them in parallel. Each bond carries a sonnet receipt only that device key can quote, and a second receipt for the same key is refused. Willow auditors, drawn at random quarterly, trace each bond to its device and check the receipt. A key found on two identities loses both bonds and a trading ban.
